references.text: Also warns against being led astray to worship other gods and heavenly bodies, with a similar exhortation to be on guard.
Contains the same warning against forgetting the Lord and following other gods, with a threat of destruction.
Warns that the heart may turn away and one may worship other gods, addressing the same theme of the heart's deception.
Prohibits worshipping other gods and bowing down to them, using the same expression for idolatry.
Joshua warns against breaking the covenant by serving other gods and bowing down to them.
Describes the consequences of turning away from the Lord and serving other gods.
The prophet rebukes the people for serving other gods, the same sin addressed in the warning in Deuteronomy.
Describes how the heart can be led astray, using the same Hebrew root for the deception of the heart.
Jesus rejects the temptation to worship anyone but God, quoting from Deuteronomy about worshipping the Lord alone.
Speaks of how a person is tempted and led astray by their own desire, parallel to the deception of the heart.
